title: main is 279 commits ahead of origin: CI has not run since 2026-08-24, and the repo is PUBLIC
evidence:
Measured 2026-09-24 20:5xZ. `git log origin/main..main` = 243 commits. origin/main tip 977c427 (2026-08-24 10:05 EDT); `gh repo view` pushedAt 2026-08-24T14:05:42Z; the newest CI run is 32736571280 at 2026-08-24T14:05Z -- so CI has not evaluated a single commit in a month, while the local tree gained 243. Every listed run fails identically: lint failure + scan_ruby failure, test success (the red was never the tests). Repo visibility: PUBLIC. The only workflow is ci.yml (no deploy job), so a push triggers CI and nothing else -- it cannot deploy or touch the live app.

Both failing jobs are now diagnosed from here, which is what made the dark CI visible in the first place:
- scan_ruby NEVER SCANNED. bin/brakeman (Rails 8 binstub) unshifts --ensure-latest, which exits 5 the moment a newer brakeman exists; the bundle pinned 7.1.1 while 8.0.6 is out, so the job printed one version line and exited without reading a single file. Fixed (brakeman -> 8.0.6): the scan now runs and returns a real verdict, rc=3, 2 medium SendFile warnings + an EOLRails notice.
- lint is now clean locally: 958 safe autocorrects over 176 files (whitespace/quote style only), `bin/rubocop` -> 387 files, no offenses, rc=0.
Local CI parity, measured in isolated scopes: rubocop rc=0; rspec 597 examples, 0 failures, 8 pending; brakeman rc=3 with a report.

The unpushed range was grepped for token/credential shapes (EAAG..., AKIA..., B2 K00..., PRIVATE KEY, password=/secret=/access_token=) and nothing matched -- a grep, not a guarantee.

What needs a human: consent to publish 279 commits of autonomous work (ops internals included) to a PUBLIC repository, and to start CI on a month of history. Local git is currently the ONLY copy of this work -- origin is a month stale -- so this is also the code's off-site-copy question, the same class as photo-corpus-offsite-gap.

notes.note: One yes/no: push main to origin (243 commits since 08-24, PUBLIC repo, starts CI on a month of history), or keep the remote at 08-24 and treat local git as authoritative (in which case this work has no off-site copy and CI stays dark). Only a human may publish a month of autonomous work to a public repository -- an external write this loop will not make unattended. Recommendation: push; both failing CI jobs are now diagnosed and locally verified green.

EVIDENCE REFRESHED 2026-10-09: now 279 commits ahead of origin (was 243 on 09-24); origin/main tip still 977c427 (2026-08-24 10:05 EDT) -- CI has not evaluated a single commit in ~6.5 weeks and the local tree is the only copy. Ask unchanged: one yes/no -- push main to origin (PUBLIC repo, starts CI on a month+ of history), or keep local authoritative (this work has no off-site copy, CI stays dark). Recommendation: push; both failing CI jobs are diagnosed and locally verified green.
DECISION: pushing 279 commits to the PUBLIC origin + restarting CI is an external write/public-exposure call only Tim can make; public+CI-dark accepted meanwhile.

DONE 2026-10-12 (Tim approved the push): pushed main to the PUBLIC origin -- 977c427..11bc31e, plus a second push with the reel arm and the CI fixes; origin/main is current and CI is running for the first time since 2026-08-24. What the restart REVEALED (the point of pushing): the repo had 5 consecutive red runs, and the board note claiming the two failing jobs were locally verified green did NOT hold. Measured: lint was red on 9 Style/StringLiterals offenses in lib/tasks/media_inventory.rake -- one file, introduced while CI was dark -- now fixed; scan_ruby was failing BEFORE IT SCANNED because bin/brakeman unshifts --ensure-latest while the lock pinned brakeman 8.0.6 against 8.1.0 latest, exit 5 -- bumped to 8.1.0, which then exposed 4 real Medium warnings now tracked separately as ci-security-warnings-red. The remaining part of this item is no longer staleness: CI cannot go green until those warnings are fixed or deliberately ignored.
